campaign.title: Unbalanced complete signed stationary-lattice gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use no external estimate unless its primary statement controls the literal signed shifted product correlation with both quarter characters, moving sampled profiles, all stationary and endpoint modules, and the required X^(1/2) energy scale. A transform identity or coefficient-blind large sieve is not a saving.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete Round-123 signed nonzero, nonexact near-alias shifted energy be bounded by a genuinely joint stationary-lattice inequality, or does the full character-Poisson stationary map rigorously self-return?
frozen_target.reference_formula: V_(M,H0)=sum_(r,s odd; j!=0,E!=0,|E|<=X^(1+rho)/L) chi_4(r)chi_4(s)Gamma_(M,H0)(r,s), with H0=ceil(X^(1/2)/D), target V_(M,H0)<<X^(1/2+epsilon), and Gamma the exact Round-123 block-square kernel.
quantities: X real at least 2; M integer asymptotic to X with all physical amplitudes frozen at X
H0=ceil(X^(1/2)/D), so K is asymptotic to L H0^2 and 1<=H0<<K
literal W_r and q_(r,k), zero extension, block endpoints, Fejer weight, and exact prefactor (J+H0-1)/H0^2
the full real ordered-pair sum with positive and negative aliases, defects, shifts, and conjugates retained
j nearest M(1/r-1/s), E=M(s-r)-jrs; the accepted j=0, nonzero exact-alias, and rapid-tail packages kept distinct
both chi_4 expansions and all quarter-shift Poisson modes on the r and s legs
candidate positive odd stationary modes p,q asymptotic to L, their exact stationary points, phases, amplitudes, boundary and nonstationary remainders
candidate dual product defect N=p(k+h)-qk and the exact relation between the dual k-gradient and the primal reciprocal alias
dual diagonal p=q,h=0, equal-mode shifted sector p=q,h!=0, and unequal-mode sector p!=q treated separately before any norm
flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner only; every hard, sharp, clipped, starred, arithmetic, and transition owner excluded

completion_criteria: Derive or refute the complete two-character Poisson and stationary expansion with exact signs, Gaussian units, amplitudes, supports, endpoint modules, and aggregate error.
Prove the stationary-mode ranges and the exact product-defect and gradient identities, including the map back to j, E, and the two reciprocal selectors.
Classify the dual diagonal, equal-mode shifted, unequal-mode, negative-shift, and quarter-sign branches without replacing the complete signed aggregate by absolute values.
Prove a target bound, a strict target-safe dual sector, a quantified signed saving, or a fixed-power inverse theorem for the complete actual-sign stationary aggregate.
If the route self-returns, prove the smallest exact involution or overstrong-norm obstruction and state what genuinely new inequality would bypass it.
Audit literal profile entries and exits, nonstationary modes, saddle-endpoint transitions, short H0, small L, and every multiplicity or one-count seam.
State exactly what follows for flat smooth UNBAL, complete UNBAL, M9-M2, M9, the quarter theorem, and every exponent.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact two-character stationary lattice of the literal shifted energy and prove the target, a strict safe sector, an inverse theorem, or the smallest rigorous no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-106 through Round-124 nonblind artifacts
required_output: Exact Poisson conventions, stationary points, phases, amplitudes, ranges, defect identities, and error ledger.
A target estimate, strict safe sector, inverse theorem, or explicit smallest no-go.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Exploit the complete dual product-defect lattice before absolute values, seeking a target bound, a strict equal-mode or unequal-mode gain, or a stronger complete-aggregate inverse theorem.
required_output: A complete dual stationary formula or a precise statement of the first invalid transform seam.
A joint inequality, strict safe sector, inverse theorem, or exact self-return with capacity accounting.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit every sign, saddle, profile, multiplicity, endpoint, diagonal correspondence, claimed cancellation, and transform-return seam in the joint stationary-lattice proposal.
required_output: A pass/fail seam table covering formulas, capacity, errors, and scope.
The maximal safe theorem or fatal correction and the exact smallest survivor.

review_seams.requirement: The proof begins with the exact Round-123 shifted survivor and does not substitute a rectangular or coefficient-free model.
Both character-Poisson legs have exact mode signs, saddle ranges, Gaussian units, principal amplitudes, endpoint transitions, and summable aggregate errors.
The product defect, dual gradient, primal alias, mode multiplicities, and diagonal correspondences are exact in every sign branch.
Any saving controls the complete actual-sign equal-mode and unequal-mode sectors before an outside norm and identifies what fails for unsigned or adversarial coefficients.
Poisson or stationary inversion is not called a gain if its k-dual mode is exactly the original reciprocal alias or if a positive dual norm is stronger than the scalar target.
A flat-smooth strict-UNBAL result is not promoted to nonflat UNBAL, hard TOP, BAL, M9-M2, M9, the quarter theorem, or an exponent without every graph bridge.
